choose.title: How will you use ilovelawyer?
choose.subtitle: You can create an organization later from the Organization page.
choose.soloDescription: Just me. You can create an organization later.
choose.firmDescription: Create an organization and invite your team.
choose.failed: We couldn't set up your workspace.

firm.title: Your firm
firm.subtitle: Only the name is required. You can add or change the rest later on the Organization page.
firm.name: Firm name
firm.registrationNumberHelp: Your SRA firm number, or your Law Society of Scotland or Northern Ireland number.
firm.sectionSubtitle: Shown to our admins beside your lawyers' applications. All optional.

invite.title: Invite your team
invite.subtitle: They'll get an email to join {{firm}}. You can invite more people later from the Organization page.

apply.submitted: Application submitted. We'll email you once we've checked it.

discard.button: Back to Solo or Law firm
discard.title: Go back to Solo or Law firm?
discard.body: {{firm}} will be removed, and any invites you sent are cancelled. You can then work solo or create a firm again.

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.subtitle: Pick the plan that fits your practice. You can skip this and choose later.
plan.loadFailed: We couldn't load the plans. You can skip this and choose one later.
plan.success: You're on {{plan}}. Your plan is active.
plan.failed: Your payment didn't go through. Nothing was charged.
plan.skipNote: Your account starts on the cheapest plan, with nothing charged, until you choose one.
plan.subtitleTrial: Pick the plan that fits your practice, or try it free for 14 days first.
plan.skipNoteTrial: You get 14 days of the cheapest plan free, from when your account is approved. Nothing is charged. After that your account becomes read-only until you choose a plan.

planChange.title: Your plan
planChange.subtitle: You're on {{current}}. It renews on {{date}}.
planChange.upgradeCharge: {{amount}} is charged to your card now, for the rest of this billing period.
planChange.upgradeLimits: {{plan}}'s cases and AI usage start straight away.
planChange.downgradeWhen: You keep {{current}} until {{date}}, then move to {{plan}} at {{fee}}/month.
planChange.downgradeNoRefund: Nothing is refunded for the rest of this period. You can change your mind before then.
planChange.downgradeCases_one: {{plan}} includes {{count}} case. If you have more, you keep them all but can't create new ones.
planChange.downgradeCases_other: {{plan}} includes up to {{count}} cases. If you have more, you keep them all but can't create new ones.
planChange.keepBody: Your scheduled switch is cancelled, and you stay on {{plan}}.

plansPage.trialEndsOn: Your free trial ends on {{date}}. Choose a plan to keep using the AI and creating cases after that.
plansPage.trialEnded: Your free trial has ended, so your account is read-only for now. Choose a plan to keep going; everything you made is still there.

banner.UK: Apply to take on clients from ilovelawyer.com.
banner.PH: Apply to get verified and show an Approved badge on your profile.
